**Texere 0.4.21** · 13 November 2026

- **Citing from Zotero works with the mouse again:** clicking a choice adds the reference; clicking elsewhere leaves your text as typed.
- **The note scrolls to each new highlight more reliably:** its cursor moves to the new line too.

Also in this version (from 0.4.19, 0.4.20): the PDF no longer reloads when you highlight or delete a highlight; the note scrolls to each new highlight in every view; new versions are shown on the home page, never installed by themselves.

Update: the **Update** button on Texere's home page.
